Ultrasonic testing in Houston: inspection scopes, and where UT training and certification are covered

This page covers UT inspection on Houston assets: refinery and chemical plant piping and vessels, ship channel tanks, pipelines and fabrication shops. If you want ultrasonic testing training or certification in Houston, see the Houston training pages linked below. Atlantis is based in Houston and offers both. It sends inspection crews to site, and it trains UT Level I and II technicians.

The plants behind Houston UT work. ExxonMobil's Baytown refinery, next to the ship channel, processes about 588,000 barrels a day and is one of the largest refineries in the country. Deer Park's refinery has been wholly owned by Pemex since Shell left the joint venture in January 2022, and it processes about 275,000 barrels of crude a day. Olefins, polymer and specialty chemical plants line the channel between them. LyondellBasell finished shutting down its Houston refinery in early 2025, which has changed the mix of work on that part of the channel. The steady demand is for thickness readings at condition monitoring locations, phased array and TOFD on welds, and corrosion mapping where wall loss is localized.

What drives vessel and piping UT in Texas. The Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation's program under the Texas Boiler Act (Health and Safety Code Chapter 755) covers boilers only. Those boilers are inspected by TDLR deputy inspectors, insurers or authorized inspection agencies. For unfired vessels and process piping, UT demand comes from the owner's API 510 and 570 programs, the mechanical integrity element of OSHA process safety management (29 CFR 1910.119) and insurer requirements. Atlantis performs the NDE and reviews the data for those programs. It does not act as the API inspector. On pipelines, the Railroad Commission of Texas oversees intrastate lines, and PHMSA covers interstate lines.

If you came here for UT training or certification. Under ASNT SNT-TC-1A, the employer certifies its technicians against its written practice. Training, experience and examinations together lead to that certification. Atlantis delivers UT Level I and II as self-paced online theory followed by practical sessions. The Practical NDT 3D simulator lets trainees practice scanning before they work on real welds. Use these pages:

  • NDT training in Houston, covering all methods and levels
  • UT Level I training in Houston
  • certification requirements in Houston, with hours and exams explained
  • UT training nationally, and phased array training
  • Practical NDT simulator for Houston teams

Technicians aiming at Level III can use the ASNT NDT Level III exam preparation. Companies that need a written practice or UT procedures can use UT Level III consulting in Houston.

If you need UT done. The national service is on ultrasonic testing. Weld coverage by phased array in the city is on PAUT inspection in Houston, line surveys on piping inspection in Houston, and every Houston service on inspection services in Houston.
